title: 第148章 破壳第147章 一举易筋境
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：从屠夫开始杀戮成神第148章破壳（..la）“轰！”
“我草你老母！”
“贼老天！”
楚生转换了几个位置，只顾着狂奔，不敢再嘴贱。
果然没有雷电再劈下来，楚生看着深邃的紫芒天空，不由得惊恐道：
“这片天，有自我意识？”
楚生目光不断朝着上空扫视着，检查是否还会有雷电劈下来。
突然，楚生似乎想到了什么。
“遭了！”
楚生几个闪身，回到原来的位置。
原位置一片焦黑，之前的两具尸体已被烧焦，现场还有火焰在燃烧。
楚生心中一沉，可惜道：“完了，完了，不会被劈没了吧？”
黑蛋就放在这里让它吸血，方才紧急情况下，他倒是把黑蛋忘记了。
喂养了这么久，楚生可不希望就这么被劈没了啊！
原来的位置上看不到有黑蛋的影子，唯有干裂的血液痕迹，以及黑色的粉末。
楚生觉得黑蛋存活下来的希望很是渺茫，但是他还没有决定放弃。
养了这么久，怎么可以一点收获都没有，就没了？
灵魂感知力扩散开来，由血迹点为核心，不断朝着外围扩散，一寸一寸地寻找。
朝着外层寻找。
一米！
五米！
十米！
二十米！
“找到了！”
楚生惊呼起来。
黑蛋被劈了二十米远，滚在一个细小的碎石裂缝中。
楚生一个弹步，便蹲在裂缝前，探出手要捡起来，然后低语道：“不会，被劈死了吧？”
“哦哟！
上面还有电，不会被劈焦糊了吧？”
楚生感受到手上的一阵酥麻，不禁担忧起来。

"I'll fuck your mother!"
"Boom!"
"What a thief!"
"Boom!"
"..."
"..."
Chu Sheng changed positions a few times, just running wildly and not daring to be mean-mouthed anymore.
Sure enough, there was no more thunder and lightning. Chu Sheng looked at the deep purple sky and said in horror:
"Does this world have self-awareness?"
Chu Sheng kept scanning the sky, checking whether there would be any more lightning strikes.
Suddenly, Chu Sheng seemed to think of something.
"Suffer it!"
Chu Sheng dodged a few times and returned to his original position.
The original location was completely charred, the two previous bodies had been charred, and there were still flames burning at the scene.
Chu Sheng's heart sank, and he said regretfully: "It's over, it's over, you won't be killed, right?"
The black egg was left here to let it suck blood. In the emergency, he had forgotten about the black egg.
After feeding him for so long, Chu Sheng didn’t want to be killed just like that!
There was no trace of the black egg in its original position, only traces of cracked blood and black powder.
Chu Sheng felt that Heidan's hope of survival was slim, but he had not decided to give up yet.
After raising it for so long, how could it be gone without any harvest?
The soul's perception spreads, starting from the bloodstain point as the core, and continues to spread towards the periphery, searching inch by inch.
Look towards the outer layer.
One meter!
Five meters!
Ten meters!
Twenty meters!
"Found it!"
Chu Sheng exclaimed.
The black egg was split twenty meters away and rolled into a small crack in the gravel.
Chu Sheng took a quick step and squatted in front of the crack, stretched out his hand to pick it up, and then whispered: "No, it was hacked to death, right?"
"Oh!
There's still electricity on it, so it won't be scorched by the chop, right? "
Chu Sheng felt a numbness in his hands and couldn't help but worry.
